description: OSHA Construction: every idea explained before it is tested, every card quoting the source words it rests on.
notice: This deck covers topics taught in the Construction courses of the Outreach Training Program run by the Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA), U.S. Department of Labor. It is built from the text of the Occupational Safety and Health Act and 29 CFR, which are U.S. Government works. This deck is independent and is not affiliated with, sponsored, endorsed or approved by OSHA or the U.S. Department of Labor. It is not an Outreach Training Program course, and studying it does not earn any OSHA or Department of Labor card, certificate or credit.

checks.what: Two independent audits read all 640 cards against 29 CFR and the OSH Act from govinfo, found word for word by the card checker, including every height, load, distance and period and the noise, slope and crane-signal figures; the hazard communication cards were then checked against the 2024 amendments (89 FR 44144)
checks.result: Two wrong cards fixed (a sloping scenario that Appendix B allows for short-term Type A digs, and the GHS revision, now Revision 7 under the 2024 rule); 5 unsupported claims removed, among them a crane clearance given as universal when 1926.1409 uses 50 feet above 350 kV; 7 ambiguous cards and 3 unclear ones fixed; topic 5 trimmed to its budget. The hazard pictogram figure now shows the amended Figure C.1.
